description:
modules/traegerview — GET /traeger/schools/occupancy (#4676, #5977): the
Träger row, the school IDs of the Träger, the school rows, the roster of
the Stichtagszahl rule, the group of each membership, the group names, the
running enrollment phases, the care offerings booked or running today and
the child of each approved enrollment for the whole school set in one
administrative transaction. Flat in the number of schools. #5977 adds the
running phases: Enrollment owns the service period, so Care Plan cannot
join it.
